tools.name: moveitpro_whoami
tools.description: The connected API key's label, company, branch (null = company-wide), scopes, plan tier and rate limits. Use it to see which tools the key can use.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_customers
tools.description: Customers, newest first, with search by name/email/phone and filters. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_leads
tools.description: Leads (prospects), newest first, with search and filters. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_get_record
tools.description: Fetch one record by type and id: customer, lead, estimate, job, crew assignment, payment, invoice, storage account, inventory session, task, claim, note, contact-log entry, SMS, email, call, employee, crew, branch, partner and more.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_estimates
tools.description: Estimates (quotes), newest first. Filter by status, customer (prospect_id), move date, booking date. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_get_estimate_section
tools.description: For one estimate: line_items = the saved price breakdown; invoices = per-phase invoices (Bill by Phase); documents = signed documents with download links.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_jobs
tools.description: Booked moves (jobs), newest first. Filter by status, crew status, move date, estimate or customer. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_get_job_charges
tools.description: The job's bills (Bills of Lading), itemized line by line.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_dispatch
tools.description: Crew assignments (dispatch) by move date, job or crew. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_payments
tools.description: Payment transactions, newest first. Filter by status, kind, customer, estimate or job. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_move_invoices
tools.description: Move invoices, newest first, optionally for one estimate. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_storage_invoices
tools.description: Storage invoices, newest first. Filter by status or storage account. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_storage_accounts
tools.description: Storage accounts, newest first. Filter by status, customer or warehouse. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_tasks
tools.description: CRM tasks, newest first. Filter by status, customer, assignee or due date. Needs a company-wide key. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_claims
tools.description: Damage claims, newest first. Filter by status, customer, job or source. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_notes
tools.description: Staff notes, newest first, for a customer, estimate, claim, task, job and more. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_activities
tools.description: The contact log (calls, texts, emails, visits logged on customers and leads), newest first. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_messages
tools.description: Message history, newest first: channel sms (filters: status, direction, branch_id, account_id), emails (same + estimate_id) or calls (direction, prospect_id). Needs the communications:read scope. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_follow_ups
tools.description: Who the office should contact next, as on the Follow-ups screen: queue leads or pending_jobs; view due (default), scheduled, all or past_move_date. Longest-uncontacted first; pages by position.

tools.name: moveitpro_completed_revenue_report
tools.description: Each month's completed (closed-out) move revenue, tax and tips, from the Bills of Lading. At most 12 months.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_team
tools.description: Company structure: employees (filters status, employee_status), crews (include_inactive) or branches. Page with next_cursor.

tools.name: moveitpro_list_lookup
tools.description: The company's configured values: lead_statuses, lead_interest_statuses, lost_reasons, cancellation_reasons, job_types, move_sizes, tariffs, warehouses, lead_sources. Use them to filter other lists with exact values.

tools.name: moveitpro_create_lead
tools.description: Create a new lead, as the website lead form does: it also starts a draft estimate with the move date and addresses, and lead workflows run. Every new lead alerts the office (in-app, plus email, push and SMS per each user's settings), and if the company uses Lead Lock it starts an automatic callback

tools.name: moveitpro_add_note
tools.description: Add a plain-text note: customer_note on a customer or lead, or an estimate note (estimate_internal, estimate_job, estimate_invoice, estimate_customer — estimate_customer shows on the CUSTOMER PORTAL). Notes cannot be edited or deleted through the API. Needs notes:write, a company-wide key and the si

tools.name: moveitpro_log_activity
tools.description: Add an entry to a customer's or lead's contact log. With a type it counts as a contact (last contacted is stamped, the person leaves the follow-up due list). run_automations: true also sends the company's automatic contact emails. Needs notes:write, a company-wide key and the signing secret.

tools.name: moveitpro_create_task
tools.description: Create a CRM task, optionally for a customer and assigned to an employee. Needs tasks:write and the signing secret. Each call creates a new task.

tools.name: moveitpro_update_task
tools.description: Change a task's title, status, priority, due date, assignee and more. Pass updated_at from the task you read (the version check); without it the tool reads the task first. Needs tasks:write and the signing secret.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moveitpro_list_customers, moveitpro_get_record, moveitpro_list_activities, moveitpro_list_messages, moveitpro_log_activity · Private data: moveitpro_whoami, moveitpro_get_record, moveitpro_get_estimate_section, moveitpro_list_activities, moveitpro_list_follow_ups, moveitpro_create_lead, moveitpro_add_note, moveitpro_log_activity, moveitpro_create_task, moveitpro_update_task · Public sink: moveitpro_list_customers, moveitpro_get_record, moveitpro_list_messages, moveitpro_create_lead · Destructive: moveitpro_create_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moveitpro_list_customers, moveitpro_get_record, moveitpro_list_activities, moveitpro_list_messages, moveitpro_log_activity · Private data: moveitpro_whoami, moveitpro_get_record, moveitpro_get_estimate_section, moveitpro_list_activities, moveitpro_list_follow_ups, moveitpro_create_lead, moveitpro_add_note, moveitpro_log_activity, moveitpro_create_task, moveitpro_update_task · Public sink: moveitpro_list_customers, moveitpro_get_record, moveitpro_list_messages, moveitpro_create_lead · Destructive: moveitpro_create_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
